provenance.note: Legacy card sealed in safe deposit box 0005, not in the starting legacy deck. Same printed code as a deck card is a second copy the mod left in the box.

faces.transcription:
RIGHT NOW
1 Destroy the remaining cards in the Legacy Deck without looking at them.
2 Immediately replace them with this new Legacy deck.
3 You're allied with Sabik. Turn this card over and continue reading.
Play it cool.

UPDATE FROM CIA
"Congratulations are evidently in order. Someone higher in the organization has decided to end your probationary period. Frankly, I do not believe you are ready, but I was overruled.
One of our loyal agents caught up with Charles Sabik last night, and in the ensuing struggle, Sabik was killed. I would have liked to bring him in alive, but it cannot be helped."
Destroy all the Restriction cards in the game.
